stage1.impression: It has a strong idea: a glowing box throws a red V of light up a dark wall, and you read the mood at once. But the whole frame is one channel of red on black. The cabinet's interior and ports burn out to pink-white, the horn sinks into the wall as a dark blob, and the floor is a hard-edged camouflage of puddles. It reads as a CG mood render, not a night photograph.

blocking_9: Cabinet interior and ports hold Ember as a saturated red with no hard clipping: clip_pct under 5 in [320,490,450,640] and under 15 in [315,650,465,710]
Floor reads as one coherent wet concrete surface with a soft, continuous reflection, not hard-edged blobs
The set outside the beam is visible in cool moonlight (flanks lum 5-12, blue above red), so it reads as a night exterior and not a black void
Board-formed concrete reads at a glance: board lines and tie holes visible in the lit wall
The horn's silhouette separates from the wall behind it (edge step at least 8)
The plinth and its reflection sit inside the frame with floor below them
Air carries the light: a visible beam and halo in haze, not just a pool on the wall

defects.what: Lit batts beside the woofer clip (21.8%) and wash from Ember red to pink-white
Port and base zone 41% clipped; the port holes are white discs (67% clipped in [330,660,360,700])
Paving puddles are hard-edged mid-scale blobs that read as camouflage; their reflections break up into patches
The reflection of the speaker is cut off by the bottom of the frame; the plinth sits nearly on the edge
Left flank is crushed black (81%); no moonlight reads
The horn is a dark maroon mass (lum 14) against a wall at lum 20; its edge step is only 3.2, so the silhouette is lost
Wall texture is low-contrast (range 19.5); the boards read faintly, more like a stained render than board-formed concrete
The frame is monochrome red (median G 2, B 4) with no secondary hue or neutral reference; it reads graded, not photographed
The V beam edges are soft but have no volume; the air between the speaker and the wall is invisible

changes.problem: The uplight overdrives the cabinet's interior so the hero colour clips to pink-white while the wall stays dim.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 21.8, p95 228; ports [330,660,360,700] clip 66.7, median RGB 254/203/200 (desaturated); wall [300,0,500,150] median only 20

change.to: 340 W, spread 60, so less energy goes into the bottom batts and ports and the cone stays near the cabinet's footprint; then render exposure 1.0 to 1.2 to bring the wall back

changes.expected: Interior batts read as glowing saturated red with clip under 5%; port discs keep some colour; wall median holds about 20-26.

changes.problem: The paving's puddles are hard-edged blobs at one scale that read as camouflage and shatter the reflection.

evidence.measured: seen in a 2x crop: sharp-edged islands about 30-80 px across; [0,720,280,800] crush 71% with isolated red specks

change.to: wet 0.6 (damp, even sheen everywhere), puddle_m 0.9 with a soft edge, so one or two broad puddles run under and in front of the plinth

changes.expected: One continuous blurred red reflection under the speaker that fades into damp concrete; no camo islands.

changes.problem: The moonlight is too weak to register, so everything outside the beam is a black void and the frame has no cool counterpoint to the red.

evidence.measured: lum_median 1.9, crush_pct 81; the right flank [650,300,800,650] crush 90

changes.expected: The wall's flanks and the floor's edges read dimly in cool blue-grey, showing the concrete's texture, with lum 5-12 and blue above red.

changes.problem: The speaker sits low, with its plinth almost on the bottom edge and its reflection cut off.

evidence.measured: the plinth base is at y about 740 of 800 and the reflection is cropped at y 800

change.to: [0.0, 0.6, 1.05], with position and lens 45 mm unchanged

changes.expected: The speaker rises about 60-70 px; the plinth and a full reflection sit inside the frame with dark floor below; the wall above still carries the V.

changes.problem: The air between the lamp and the wall shows nothing, so the light reads as a projection on the wall, not light in a night atmosphere.

evidence.measured: the beam edge is a gradual 180 px ramp with a max step of 1.3; no volumetric shaft is visible in front of the wall

changes.expected: A faint red shaft rises off the cabinet and a soft halo surrounds the horn, which also lifts the horn's backdrop.

changes.problem: The concrete's boards read only faintly; the wall looks like a stained flat surface.

change.to: bump 3.5, vary 0.2, with tex_scale set so boards run about 150 mm high and the tie holes at ties [0.6, 0.62] land in the lit zone

changes.expected: Horizontal board lines and tie-hole dots read clearly under the grazing uplight.

changes.problem: The horn's silhouette disappears into the wall because nothing rims it.

evidence.measured: edge step 3.2 over 5 px; horn [300,340,480,440] median 14 against wall 20

change.to: [-2.2, 1.0, 5.0] (higher behind-left, closer to the speaker's plane), so the cool moonlight catches the top and left rim of the horn's resin

changes.expected: A thin cool rim on the horn's top and left edge separates it from the red wall.

changes.problem: Even after the light change the port discs will be the hottest point, and Khronos PBR Neutral pushes them to white.

evidence.measured: clip_pct 40.9, median G 171 / B 166 against R 253

change.to: roll off highlights above 0.85 with a soft shoulder that keeps hue (no desaturation to white), applied the same on all eight slides

changes.expected: The ports glow as a hot red-orange with detail, not white holes.

out_of_scope.request: Less light straight through the port openings
out_of_scope.why: The ports are fixed by the cabinet's acoustic design and light really passes through them; handled with exposure and a highlight shoulder instead.

out_of_scope.request: A brighter horn with more light through its resin
out_of_scope.why: The top batts stop the uplight before it reaches the horn; that is the real cabinet, so the horn is separated with rim light and haze instead.
